surface: plate_core.markers + plate_core.self_migrate marker merge apply path
summary: self-migrate marker merge ignores PLATES-CORE markers inside fenced code blocks, uses fence-aware section boundaries when merging, and refuses to write merged files that fail post-merge marker or fence balance validation (#1252).
migration_impact: Adopters running `gh plate self-migrate --merge-markers --apply-markers` get safer AGENTS.md sectional merges; corrupted output is reported as merge_conflict instead of being written. No config change required.
agent_notes: Root cause was merge walks treating fenced example END markers in upstream-template-sync as structural closes.
